narrative: The foul papers in order, the earliest sheet on top, the margin already full of small marks and no new speech started. Lower on a later sheet, two words in the margin and no lines under them. The castle-wall page is the last one turned. A vertical line drawn down the margin beside a speech. The words of the speech are left standing. Nothing is written beside the line, and nothing is struck out.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the papers through to the wall, and drew the line.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on draft in Marks, and one line
